subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): guard assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork against malformed URLs

question: Should `assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork` intentionally standardize malformed URL failures to only `TypeError("Invalid URL")`, or must it also preserve the non-sensitive `ERR_INVALID_URL` code for plugin compatibility?
rationale: The patch correctly removes credential-bearing parser state, but the helper is public SDK surface and current callers can observe Node's native error code even though no repository caller was found relying on it.

options.title: Approve the sanitized contract
options.body: Treat TypeError plus the stable Invalid URL message as the supported public contract and accept removal of native parser fields.

options.title: Preserve the error code
options.body: Add a non-sensitive ERR_INVALID_URL code to the new TypeError while continuing to omit input, base, cause, and other parser state.

recommendation.title: Approve the sanitized contract
recommendation.body: Treat TypeError plus the stable Invalid URL message as the supported public contract and accept removal of native parser fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent network-policy refactor history makes steipete the strongest available owner for confirming the public SDK compatibility boundary.
